description.value: The Teahouse has occupied the heritage building at Ferguson Point in Stanley Park since 1978, offering west coast seafood and seasonal menus with unobstructed ocean views from window-lined dining rooms and a waterfront patio. Part of the Sequoia Company of Restaurants, it sits directly along the Stanley Park Seawall—one of the most heavily cycled routes in Vancouver—making it a natural candidate rest stop for touring cyclists. The restaurant operates a full dinner, brunch, and lunch service with dedicated private event spaces including a glass-roofed conservatory and garden lawn.
